question: Does P2Rank, run blind on the ligand-stripped structure, recover the residues that the known ligand actually contacts?
metric: Jaccard / recall between the P2Rank top-1 pocket residue set and the known-ligand contact residue set (4.5 A heavy-atom cutoff)
null_model: random residue subset of the same size drawn from the observed chain; exact hypergeometric survival function
